searchText: When is it expected that we move our mainnet beacon chains to hit our execution clients on the Engine API port? you can do that now on geth and I think others as well Is it correct / safe to do so? Releases with the final config are planned to be out by 21 August at the latest. To avoid getting warnings in logs about mismatched configuration I’d wait for those.
